data.title: Iran weighs options as US pressure, nuclear impasse deepen | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: A senior Israeli defense official said Iran's room for maneuver has narrowed amid US sanctions, while Israel is preparing for the possibility that an Iranian move could spiral out of control.
